rule: Every public base table is either scoped (has shelter_id, so 0392/0396's restrictive policies filter it) or recorded here as deliberately unscoped, with a reason in checkable terms. scripts/check-tenancy-shared-tables.mjs fails on a table with no column and no record, and on a record for a table that now has the column or no longer exists. Item #tnc10; docs/decisions/2026-11-17-tenancy-unscoped-tables.md.

tables.shelters: The tenant table itself; its row is the shelter.
tables.permission_activities: Card catalogue: code-defined, identical for every shelter.
tables.card_features: Card catalogue: code-defined, identical for every shelter.
tables.card_grants: Card catalogue. Holds assignments as well as definitions: per-shelter roles and cards are Part 10 (#omt6u), not here.
tables.card_includes: Card catalogue. Holds assignments as well as definitions: Part 10 (#omt6u), not here.
tables.features: Card catalogue: code-defined, identical for every shelter.
tables.translatable_fields: Schema metadata: which columns are translatable.
tables.translatable_labels: Schema metadata: which labels are translatable.
tables.bill_kinds: Shared-for-now lookup list. Gap: shelter two editing a value changes it for shelter one. Needs a column plus per-shelter values; for the planner to file.
tables.blood_test_types: Shared-for-now lookup list. Same gap as bill_kinds.
tables.immunization_types: Shared-for-now lookup list. Same gap; archived_at, sort and cost are edited per shelter.
tables.procedure_types: Shared-for-now lookup list. Same gap as bill_kinds.
tables.frequency: Shared-for-now lookup list. Same gap as bill_kinds.
tables.units: Shared-for-now lookup list. Same gap as bill_kinds.
tables.group_origins: Shared-for-now lookup list. Same gap as bill_kinds.
